title: One session issuer: every sign-in door and renewal re-checks the principal
deviations_from_card: (1) Shipped as ONE feat commit carrying tests + code, then a docs commit, rather than test-then-feat: the issuer test file cannot load without the module, and its source ratchet is red until every door is ported, so a test-only commit would have been red. Test-first order was still followed in the working tree (14 red cases recorded before any production code). (2) Principal for operator/open carries an optional workspaceId (the switch renewal re-mints them onto the chosen team); still no org/role/op/sub field on any member. (3) issueSession takes an options object {now?, entered?}; entered:false is the switch renewal, which never set kp_entered and still does not (cookie set byte-identical per door). (4) Login for a user whose org has NO team at all answers the existing uniform LOGIN_CREDENTIALS_INVALID 401 (no new error code, no catalog change); landingWorkspaceFor keeps DEFAULT_WORKSPACE_ID for home-org users so today's landing is unchanged there. (5) Refusal reasons: inactive (disabled), unknown_user (deleted), foreign_workspace (other org OR nonexistent workspace). Only 'disabled' is refused, not 'invited' - verifyCredentials already admits invited-with-password accounts and refusing them would make login stricter than the card asked. (6) switch-workspace: inactive/unknown_user -> 401 + clearSession (clears session AND kp_entered); foreign_workspace -> 404 'Unknown workspace.' (same answer as the route's existing org check). The route's membership 403 check still runs BEFORE the issuer, so a disabled user switching to a team they are not a member of gets 403 with the cookie kept (it still cannot renew).
notes: Cases: acceptance 0 of 7 before, 7 of 7 after. Test-level: 14 red before (12 in session-issuer.test.ts - file could not load; 1 switch disabled-renewal; 1 login own-org landing); 3 door attribute pins were green on the base by design (they pin today's attributes). Cookie attributes pinned byte-for-byte: issuer output vs the literal old options object, same Next serializer, clock-derived Expires masked. tsc: the only errors are under the untracked kpi-sim/ directory (a foreign snapshot tree, not tracked, not mine); zero errors on tracked paths, so recorded 0. test:perf is red, but ONLY on foreign routes (hire-from-need, analyze, devcase/*, repo-scan/*, jds/*, tasks/*, companion/* ... +2 modules / ~30KB each) - session-issuer.ts is imported only by the 5 auth doors, none of which appear; the growth matches siblings' uncommitted app/_lib/github/client.ts + repo-snapshot.ts edits. The job-ingest 402/400 line did not appear. Full npm run test:unit exit 0. r03 platform-auth-api/A's require-operator.ts home-org gates untouched (homeOrgReader reads the org claim, which the issuer sets from users.org_id = the same value every door stamped before). REBASE NOTES for unmerged autopilot/enforce-per-user-session-revocation-list-to-cove (f6e59d87f): (a) app/api/auth/logout/route.ts - on main the file is now 10 lines: `import { clearSession } from "@/app/_lib/auth/session-issuer"` and `return clearSession(NextResponse.json({ ok: true }))`. The branch's rewrite must keep its revocation block but replace its final `const res = NextResponse.json({ok, revoked, scope}); res.cookies.set(SESSION_COOKIE, "", EXPIRED); res.cookies.set(ENTERED_COOKIE, "", {...maxAge:0}); return res;` with `return clearSession(NextResponse.json({ ok: true, revoked, scope: ... }));` and drop its `const EXPIRED` + ENTERED_COOKIE/SESSION_COOKIE-for-set imports - the source ratchet in session-issuer.test.ts fails on any `cookies.set(SESSION_COOKIE` outside the issuer. (b) app/_lib/auth/session.ts - no conflict with this card (this card did not edit session.ts); the branch's move of SESSION_TTL_MS into edge-verify.ts is compatible because session.ts keeps re-exporting it and session-issuer.ts imports it from ./session. (c) docs/features/organization/README.md and scripts/docs/feature-doc-map.json - textual conflict only: this card appended "app/_lib/auth/session-issuer.ts" at the end of the organization doc's sourceGlobs list (after app/features/settings/workspace/**) and added the 'One session issuer' paragraph before 'A **demo session cannot switch at all**' plus a 'Session issuer' Surface row. (d) If the branch wants revocation on renewal, the seam is issueSession's resolve() in session-issuer.ts.
